messages:
elaine: heads-up — acme signed an LOE that expects SSO + user provisioning for pilot. they want a firm ship week, but we only have capacity for a minimal pilot. 

elaine: options i see: (1) shrink pilot MVP to core auth + email invites (2) keep SSO but move pilot to v1 and run an extended beta. need product + eng tradeoffs.

devin: engineering constraints: full SAML + SCIM work is ~3w (dev + e2e + infra). can we scope SCIM to just create/update user attributes and defer group sync?

omar: depends on compliance asks. acme requires audit log entries for provisioning. if we do minimal SCIM we still need logging hooks (adds ~2d).

sandra: customer impact: Acme's pilot needs automated provisioning otherwise ops overhead kills the pilot adoption. their success metric is 'seat population within 48h' after invite.

chris: alternative: provide a managed onboarding service for the pilot (manual provisioning initially) + engineering ships SAML-only MVP. ops team can run a short script to onboard customers for first 2 pilots.

elaine: good angle. trade: manual ops lowers engineering lift but adds headcount time. we can promise automation by v1.

jonah: timeline math — if we choose SAML-only MVP + manual onboarding: pilot start in 2w, automation by v1 (+6w after pilot). If we try SAML+SCIM minimal: pilot start in 5w, automation included.

devin: technical risks: SCIM regressions on tenant-edge cases. shipping minimal SCIM without full regression coverage raises support load.

omar: QA ask: can we run the pilot as an internal staged rollout (one acme team at a time)? reduces blast radius.

elaine: proposal: pick SAML-only MVP for pilot. promise SCIM + audit logs for v1. commit to ops-assisted onboarding (documented runbook). set milestone reset: pilot -> ship week in 2w, v1 GA target +8w.

chris: +1 from me. i'll scope runbook and oncall rota for first 4 weeks.

sandra: i'll communicate revised pilot expectations to acme and confirm metrics (seat pop <48h).

devin: i'll schedule engineering work: SAML in sprint, signal flag for quick rollback, SCIM backlog for v1.

elaine: ok — next actions: 
• sandra to update acme (today) 
• chris to publish runbook (48h) 
• devin to add tasks and PRD changes (EOD) 
• calendar-bot: set milestone meeting Friday 10am to ratify timeline

calendar-bot: "Event created: Pilot scope check-in — Friday 10:00"

elaine: tagging this thread resolved for now. we'll reopen if acme pushes for automation before pilot start. :thumbsup:
